text: Section 16(ia): Standard deduction of Rs 50,000 is available from salary income.
Section 80C: Deduction up to Rs 1,50,000 for eligible investments (e.g., PPF, ELSS, LIC, etc.).
Section 80D: Deduction for medical insurance premium (Rs 25,000, or Rs 50,000 for senior citizens).
Section 24(b): Deduction up to Rs 2,00,000 for interest on home loan (self-occupied property).
Section 10(13A): HRA exemption is available as per least of actual HRA, rent paid minus 10% salary, or 50%/40% of salary (metro/non-metro).
Section 10(5): LTA exemption is available for travel within India, subject to conditions.
Section 16(iii): Professional tax paid is allowed as deduction from salary income.
Section 10: Certain allowances (e.g., children education, hostel, transport) are exempt up to specified limits.
Section 112A: Long-term capital gains on listed equity shares above Rs 1 lakh taxed at 10% (without indexation).
Section 111A: Short-term capital gains on listed equity shares taxed at 15%.
Section 48/112: Long-term capital gains on non-equity assets taxed at 20% with indexation.
Section 87A: Rebate up to Rs 12,500 for resident individuals with total income up to Rs 5 lakh.
Surcharge applies on total income exceeding Rs 50 lakh as per Finance Act slabs.
Health & Education Cess: 4% on income-tax plus surcharge.
